text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "The Victoria Mile! And the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! All the glory of this year's turf Tiara belongs to her!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A complete sweep of the Senior Year Tiara GⅠs!
The one who achieved this monumental feat
is Verxinaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, everyone,
feasts your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Grant me flawless brilliance!
—The pride of a magnificent tiara...!
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Sis,
you're so cool..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!
It's sparkling...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You're right.
Sis is... truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've definitely decided on the Tiara route!!
I really want that sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to be...
just like you, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
You've really gotten serious about this, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure you can do it.
...If it's you, Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because you're so much like my sister.
...Unlike me.

Verxina reigned at the top of the Tiara route
in both name and reality.
She had achieved the form she always dreamed of. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I will become her regret.
—At the Japan Cup!"

Verxina declared firmly.
In her stance, not a trace of fearful weakness remained...
Even without words, she knew beyond doubt that she was "strong."
choice_data_list: (Looks like she doesn't need any more encouragement.)
(Looks like she doesn't need any more encouragement, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Before that... there's something I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
There's something... I want to tell her."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why,
could you... lend me your courage?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I think... I'm going to bare my weak side to her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show them that I'm no different...
And that even so, they can become this strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...However, showing my weakness on my own... is scary.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So... would it be all right
if I relied on you?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just like always.
Please give me... your strength.
choice_data_list: ...Showing weakness is another form of strength.
...Showing weakness is another form of strength, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: Then you can definitely do it. Because—
Then you can absolutely do it. Because—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Because I am strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, nah, changed my mind!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll go with this Super Delicious Deluxe
Hamburger Set~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Ready to order, plea~seâ¡

I offered to look after Vivlos so that
Verxina and Cheval Grand could have a quiet talk,
which was fine and all, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and in addition to this~...
I'd like to get a parfait too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The head-over-heels deluxe all-fruit parfait, and...
the 1kg Ultra Chocolate sundae...
I'm curious about both, so I'll take both♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, but there's no way I can finish all of this...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If you'll eat with me, Trainer,
I feel like I might just manage it...?

...If it's come to this, I just have to brace myself.
By now, Verxina is probably going to talk to Cheval Grand too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, are you there?
...I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to talk to me...?
...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...It's about how my big sis is super weak."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...What are you talking about?
Big Sis is... strong, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If you're talking about what happened at last year's Japan Cup,
that was... just unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"After witnessing power like that,
not breaking... would be the strange thing."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Sister stood right back up.
If that isn't true strength... then what is—?”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I was scared.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...The truth is, I was scared of Gentil-san the entire time."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The day of our first match race,
I was made to feel... "I can never beat this person"...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And then over, and over, and over again...
"I'm scared," "I might not win"—
I couldn't stop feeling that way.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The truth is...
I'm still scared... even now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many results I achieve,
that fierce intensity remains etched into my body—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...To tell you the truth, I'm actually really anxious about the upcoming Japan Cup too."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm not amazing at all. Not in the slightest.
I'm far, far weaker than you think...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
But you know.
Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If you all cheer for me,
I know I can do my best."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I can stand tall and say that I will surely win.
...No matter how terrifying it may be."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If I can beat her
in the next race..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I want Cheval to believe in herself, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Since I was able to do it,
I want you to believe... that you can do it too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Because we're family, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's impossible.
After all, we're... different.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: They're totally different beings, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...And unlike my sister,
I'm... a coward.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "......I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When Big sis showed her weakness...
To be honest... I felt... a little... relieved.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If Big sis stops trying her best...
she'll end up just like me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"To think that... I won't have to be compared anymore...
I... I...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No!
That's not true, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to get back on my feet there,
I... was able to become just like you.

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
"A blood blister... But Big Sis did way more
practice swings than this... I can do it too...!
...301... 302...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the old days, even if you fell a little behind,
you'd secretly work hard and always keep up...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You absolutely never gave up!
That strength of yours... is my pride."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Being your big sister is my pride.
And the same goes for Vivlos. Mom, Dad...
everyone is my source of strength."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, don't say such sad things.
Please don't deny that we're 'family.'"
(Squeeze...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed,
we are completely different beings. But...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It's the closest one.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Let me prove it. That your sister is very, very strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a "big sister" to you all.
Being a sister is what I want.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —That is why I will win.
